Study
The College offers courses of study in Arts up to Degree (Pass& Major) level under Guwahati University. The Higher Secondary Courses ofthis college offers 10+2 level courses under the ambit of Assam HigherSecondary Education Council. Though the medium of instruction is generallyAssamese, in certain cases, English and Bodo is retained as complementary toAssamese.
HIGHERSECONDARY COURSE
CompulsorySubject
1. English.
2. MIL (Assamese/Bodo).
Note: A Student may offer Alternative English in lieu of MIL.
ElectiveSubjects
Students are free to choose any three elective Subjects:
1. Economics
2. History
3. Political Science
4. Logic & Philosophy
5. Education
6. Sanskrit
7. Geography
T.D.C.SEMESTER (ARTS) COURSE
CompulsorySubject
1. English.
2. MIL (Assamese/Bodo).
ElectiveSubjects
Students are free to choose any two elective Subjects:
1. Economics.
2. History
3. Political Science.
4. Philosophy
5. Education.
6.Sanskrit.
7.Geography.
MajorSubjects
1. Assamese.
2. English.
3. Economics.
4. Education.
5. History.
6. Political Science.
7. Philosophy.
8. Bodo.
